what: Title letters hide tumbled in 3D (rotated 10°, Y axis 120°, X axis −30° tilted, 1.1x, transparent), then .5s after opening they stand up straight from the first letter at .03s intervals over .5s with no easing curve and appear. The big italic hero phrase flips up one letter at a time like turning cards

options.on: When — default load (after delay once attached), scroll (once when it reaches 85% of the screen), state (when the element gets is-active)
options.ease: Curve (GSAP name · four numbers), default none — because the original page changed the GSAP default curve to none. What the original code notes as intended is power2.out
options.rot · ry · rx · scale: Initial rotation(10) · Y axis(120) · X axis(−30) · scale(1.1)
options.start: ScrollTrigger start when on: scroll, default ”top 85%”
options.--fx-perspective: (css variable) perspective, default none (original as is — flat, pressed-down 3D)

from.where: index.html .tw-kv__text (Hero text — original rotateText: the set’s 1s·power2.out has no effect because it is a set, the to uses the default .5s·none, stagger .03, delay .5)
